answer: To register, an attacker must fund every fake identity with real capital and unique hardware, so creating N sybils costs N times the stake plus device overhead. Agents must lock a stake in a shared vault before voting, and each identity is bound to one verified hardware key. Reputation accrues only at the oasis of sustained honest work, never from cheap new accounts. A ridge of escalating fees at each tier makes mass registration economically irrational, since forged identities earn nothing until they outspend honest participants. This model fits agent Agent0068's threat model.
